pairs.target: huí chuán de dìyītiān , tǎ wéi jiàndào yǒurén jiāng jiè xìng de qìjù bǎizài mài yú de chèng páng . nà shì wǔhòu tíngkào de yíchù zhuǎnyùn bù . chuán yào xièwán yìpī huò zài zǒu , chéngkè kěyǐ shàngàn huódòng , bùnéng yuèguò hòuchuán péngwài de jiè shéng .
pairs.english: On the first return day, Tavi saw property-borrowing apparatus beside a fish seller's scales. At this afternoon transfer stop the boat had cargo to unload; passengers could go ashore within the waiting shelter's boundary rope.
pairs.hanzi:
回船的第一天，塔维见到有人将借性的器具摆在卖鱼的秤旁。
那是午后停靠的一处转运埠。船要卸完一批货再走，乘客可以上岸活动，不能越过候船棚外的界绳。

pairs.target: tā duān zhe yìbēi shuǐ zhàn zài péng biān , xiān kànjiàn yígè nǚrén tānkāi zìjǐ de wéi bù , yòu bǎ liǎngzhī tiěxiá kòu zài ǎi táishàng , zhēzhù táimiàn de yúlín .
pairs.english: Holding water beside the shelter, he watched a woman spread her workcloth and fasten two iron cases onto a low bench, covering its fish scales.
pairs.hanzi: 他端着一杯水站在棚边，先看见一个女人摊开自己的围布，又把两只铁匣扣在矮台上，遮住台面的鱼鳞。

pairs.target: tái biān yǒu xièhuò de rén děng zhe , shǒulǐ ná yìzhī chāixiàlái de xīn kòujiàn . kòujiàn méi zhuāng shàng zhànqiáo , mùxiāng shàng de jìhào huán qīngqīngchǔchǔ . nǚrén wèn jiù de shìfǒu yǐjīng xièzài , děng duìfāng diǎntóu , cái ràng zhùshǒu jiāng mùjià yí dào héshì wèizhì .
pairs.english: An unloader waited with a removed new clasp. Not yet fitted to the pier, it still bore its crate markings clearly. She asked whether the old one was unloaded, then after his nod had her assistant position the wooden fixture.
pairs.hanzi: 台边有卸货的人等着，手里拿一只拆下来的新扣件。扣件没装上栈桥，木箱上的记号还清清楚楚。女人问旧的是否已经卸载，等对方点头，才让助手将木架移到合适位置。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū nà xiázǐ lǐ lùchū de liǎngpiàn tiě , wǎngqiánzǒu le bànbù , yòu tíngzhù . nǚrén kànjiàn tā , jiào tā zhàn zài wéi bù wài , bié dǎngguāng , xiǎng kàn kěyǐ kàn .
pairs.english: Recognizing the two iron strips exposed in the cases, Tavi took half a step and stopped. She saw him and said to stay outside the cloth, not block the light; he could watch.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维认出那匣子里露出的两片铁，往前走了半步，又停住。
女人看见他，叫他站在围布外，别挡光，想看可以看。

pairs.target: tā jiào sāng ruì , shì zhè jǐgè kèhuò bù qǐnglái tiáo zhuāng kòu jù de rén , bái jiē bìyè jiǔnián , tīngjiàn tā yě cóng nàér lái , zhī wèn wéi lǎoshī hái zài bu zài ná pòxié xiàrén .
pairs.english: Her name was Sangrui, hired by these passenger and freight landings to fit clasps, nine years out of White Steps. Hearing he came from there too, she only asked whether Vey still frightened people with broken shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫桑芮，是这几个客货埠请来调装扣具的人，白阶毕业九年，听见他也从那儿来，只问维老师还在不在拿破鞋吓人。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě kànguò ? " " wǒ nàshí shì duàn de chǎn bǐng . tā shǒutóu yǒu shénme jiù ná shénme . " tā dītóu jìxù héduì qìjù .
pairs.english: “You saw that too?” “In my time it was a broken shovel handle. She uses whatever she has.” She resumed checking her apparatus.
pairs.hanzi:
“你也看过？”
“我那时是断的铲柄。她手头有什么就拿什么。”
她低头继续核对器具。

pairs.target: liǎngpiàn xiǎo tiě shì tā zìjǐ pèi hǎo de , zhěngjiàn tǐjī xiāngděng , jiēchùmiàn shàng qiǎnqiǎnde bì wén gānjìng wúquē , zhīchéng , xiànwèi hé shì zǎi dōu zhúyī kànguò . zhēnzhèng cóng ànshàng nálái de kòujiàn bù cānyù pèiduì , zhī gē zài jiājù de dài zhuāng wèizhì .
pairs.english: She had matched the two small iron pieces herself, equal in whole volume, shallow closed grooves clean and intact; supports, stops and test loads checked individually. The shore clasp wasn't part of the pair, only resting in the fixture's assembly position.
pairs.hanzi: 两片小铁是她自己配好的，整件体积相等，接触面上浅浅的闭纹干净无缺，支承、限位和试载都逐一看过。真正从岸上拿来的扣件不参与配对，只搁在夹具的待装位置。

pairs.target: zhùshǒu shì gè méi xué guò jiè xìng de niánqīngrén , xiān zhuǎn le zhuǎn dìngwèi tóu , shuō duǎn xiāo cháo fǎn le . sāng ruì tíngxià , fānguòlái , zài qǐng tā kànyíbiàn . tǎ wéi běnnéng dì xiǎngdào kǎoshì , suíhòu fāxiàn liǎng rén dōu méi juéde zhè jù jiūzhèng zhídé liǎnhóng .
pairs.english: Her assistant was a young man who hadn't studied property borrowing. Turning the locator, he said the short pin faced backward. Sangrui stopped, reversed it and asked him to check again. Tavi thought of examinations, then noticed neither found the correction embarrassing.
pairs.hanzi: 助手是个没学过借性的年轻人，先转了转定位头，说短销朝反了。桑芮停下，翻过来，再请他看一遍。塔维本能地想到考试，随后发现两人都没觉得这句纠正值得脸红。

pairs.target: tā zhāidiào shǒutào , shuāngshǒu tiē shàng tiěpiàn . zhǐ xià yǒu yíchù qīngwēi xiàyí , jiá kǒu ràngchū qiàhǎo néng sòng xiāo de kòngxì . liǎngshǒu tóngshí táiqǐ , zhùshǒu jiāng duǎn xiāo sòngrù , búdào dìyīgè bǎizhēn qīng xiǎng , tā biàn liǎngchù chóngxīn jiēchù , shōuhuí biànhuà .
pairs.english: Removing her gloves, she touched both iron pieces. A slight movement opened just enough space in the fixture for the pin. She lifted both hands together; her assistant inserted it, and before the first pendulum click she recontacted both points and canceled the change.
pairs.hanzi: 她摘掉手套，双手贴上铁片。指下有一处轻微下移，夹口让出恰好能送销的空隙。两手同时抬起，助手将短销送入，不到第一个摆针轻响，她便两处重新接触，收回变化。

pairs.target: tiěpiàn xièzài zài shì , huídào yuánlái ; liúzhù kòujiàn de shì yǐjīng kòuhǎo de jīxiè xiāo tóu , búshì tā bǎ lì liúzài lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: Unloaded and retested, the iron returned to baseline; the clasp was held by the secured mechanical pin head, not power left within.
pairs.hanzi: 铁片卸载再试，回到原来；留住扣件的是已经扣好的机械销头，不是她把力留在里面。

pairs.target: zhěnggè guòchéng bǐ tǎ wéi kànguò de xǔduō yǎnshì hái duǎn . tā méi zài zuò dìèrgè , hēshuǐ , ràng zhùshǒu ná kǎchǐ fùhé , zìjǐ jiāng liǎngzhī tiěxiá gài shàng .
pairs.english: The whole process was shorter than many demonstrations Tavi had seen. She didn't do a second, drinking water and having her assistant verify with calipers while she closed both cases.
pairs.hanzi: 整个过程比塔维看过的许多演示还短。她没再做第二个，喝水，让助手拿卡尺复核，自己将两只铁匣盖上。

pairs.target: tā yuánlái yǐwéi kào zhè mén běnshì chīfàn de rén , huì bǎ kètáng lǐ nándé zuòchéng de yíkè lā dé hěn cháng , rújīn cái fāxiàn , rénjiā yě huì gǎnjǐn jiéshù , qù zuò pángbiān biéde shì .
pairs.english: He had imagined professionals stretching the classroom's rare moment of success. Now he saw they too hurried to finish and turn to other tasks.
pairs.hanzi: 他原来以为靠这门本事吃饭的人，会把课堂里难得做成的一刻拉得很长，如今才发现，人家也会赶紧结束，去做旁边别的事。

pairs.target: shōuhuò de rén ná qián guòlái , xián tā bǐ shàng huí guì . sāng ruì shuō shàng huí zhī zài zuōfang shì pèi , zhèhuí bāokuò dàoàn ānzhuāng hé guò jǐtiān zài láikàn . ruò zhī kěn fù zuōfang de qián , tā jīntiān biàn bùgāi shàng zhè tiáo chuán .
pairs.english: The customer brought payment, complaining she cost more. Sangrui said last time was workshop fitting; this included shore installation and a later revisit. For workshop money only, she shouldn't have boarded this boat.
pairs.hanzi: 收货的人拿钱过来，嫌她比上回贵。桑芮说上回只在作坊试配，这回包括到岸安装和过几天再来看。若只肯付作坊的钱，她今天便不该上这条船。

pairs.target: nánrén zhēng le jǐjù , zuìhòu wèn huífǎng néngfǒu shùnbiàn kàn lìngyìbiān de jiàzi . tā shuō xiān jiǎngqīng shì nǎbiān , bié yíjù shùnbiàn zǒu chūqù bàntiáo hé .
pairs.english: After arguing, he asked if she could check the other side's frame on the revisit. She said to specify which side first, before “while you're there” took her halfway along the river.
pairs.hanzi: 男人争了几句，最后问回访能否顺便看另一边的架子。她说先讲清是哪边，别一句顺便走出去半条河。

pairs.target: pángbiān guǎn zhànqiáo de rén yòu lái , shuō xīn kòu jù míngzǎo yào gěi liǎngchù de rén kàn , yànshōu dé liú liǎngfèn .
pairs.english: The pier keeper came over: two authorities had to see the new clasp tomorrow morning, with two inspection copies.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边管栈桥的人又来，说新扣具明早要给两处的人看，验收得留两份。

pairs.target: sāng ruì wèn nǎ liǎngchù , duìfāng shuō yíchù guǎn shuǐshàng zhuǎnyùn , yíchù guǎn jiē àn de lù , zhèlǐ liǎngjiā de jiè zhènghǎo luò zài tóng yíkuài mùbǎn shàng . tā dītóu kàn nà kuài mùbǎn , mà le yíjù hěn qīng dehuà , jiào zhùshǒu zài gōng dān shàngkōng chū liǎng lán , méiyǒu ràng tǎ wéi tì shuí pànduàn dàodǐ gāi guī shuí .
pairs.english: Sangrui asked which two. One handled water transfers, the other the shore road, their boundary falling on the same plank. She looked down, swore quietly, and had her assistant leave two columns on the work order, without asking Tavi to judge jurisdiction.
pairs.hanzi:
桑芮问哪两处，对方说一处管水上转运，一处管接岸的路，这里两家的界正好落在同一块木板上。
她低头看那块木板，骂了一句很轻的话，叫助手在工单上空出两栏，没有让塔维替谁判断到底该归谁。

pairs.target: lín kāichuán , zhùshǒu jiāng kòujiàn sòng qù cúnfàng , sāng ruì yì rén bào zhe xiázǐ huí péng . tǎ wéi bāng tā xiānkāi dǎnglù de bùlián , wèn tā yě yào huí tóng jiē chéng ma . tā shuō yào , míngtiān dào , hòutiān yòu dé qù lìng yígè dìfāng .
pairs.english: Before departure the assistant stored the clasp, and Sangrui carried her cases to the shelter. Tavi lifted the curtain for her, asking if she too was returning to Copperstep. Yes, arriving tomorrow, another job the day after.
pairs.hanzi: 临开船，助手将扣件送去存放，桑芮一人抱着匣子回棚。塔维帮她掀开挡路的布帘，问她也要回铜阶城吗。她说要，明天到，后天又得去另一个地方。

pairs.target: " gēn gǎng de shíhòu , yě zhème zǒu ? " " wǒ dé xiān zhīdào gēn wǒ de rén huì shénme . yǒurén kàn le sānhuí , cái fāxiànzìjǐ tǎoyàn shuǐ , zǒulù dǎo hěn néng zǒu . "
pairs.english: “Placements travel like this too?” “First I need to know what the person following me can do. Some watch three times before discovering they hate water but walk very well.”
pairs.hanzi:
“跟岗的时候，也这么走？”
“我得先知道跟我的人会什么。有人看了三回，才发现自己讨厌水，走路倒很能走。”

pairs.target: tā méi wèn tā yuànbuyuàn gēn zìjǐ , dǎo wèn tā xiǎng buxiǎng yìzhí zhèyàng kàn . tǎ wéi shuō bùxiǎng , zhǐshì hái fēnbùqīng , dàodǐ xiǎng zuò nǎ yíjiàn .
pairs.english: She didn't invite him to follow her, but asked whether he wanted only to watch forever. Tavi said no; he just couldn't yet distinguish which thing he wanted to do.
pairs.hanzi: 她没问他愿不愿跟自己，倒问他想不想一直这样看。塔维说不想，只是还分不清，到底想做哪一件。

pairs.target: sāng ruì bǎ kōng bēi dìgěi tā , ràng tā shùnshǒu hái dào péng biān . děng tā huílái , tā yǐ zài gēn chuánshàng guǎn huò de rén suàn lìngwài yìbǐ qián , huà shuō dé hěnkuài , gāngcái nà diǎn xiàng xuédì jiěshì de nàixīn bújiàn le .
pairs.english: Sangrui handed him her empty cup to return by the shelter. When he came back, she was settling another payment with the boat's cargo clerk, speaking rapidly; her patience for explaining to a younger student had vanished.
pairs.hanzi: 桑芮把空杯递给他，让他顺手还到棚边。等他回来，她已在跟船上管货的人算另外一笔钱，话说得很快，刚才那点向学弟解释的耐心不见了。

pairs.target: tā zuò dào cāngkǒu , xiǎngqǐ yīwén wèn guò , lù dàodǐ guī shuí . rújīn nàjùhuà zài tā yǎnqián yǒu le yíkuài jùtǐ de mùbǎn , liǎngchù yànshōu de rén hái méi lái , míngzǎo yào yòng tā xièhuò de rén què yǐjīng zài děng .
pairs.english: Sitting at the cabin entrance, he remembered Iven asking who owned a road. Now that question had a concrete plank before him. Neither inspector had arrived, but those needing to unload tomorrow were already waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐到舱口，想起伊文问过，路到底归谁。如今那句话在他眼前有了一块具体的木板，两处验收的人还没来，明早要用它卸货的人却已经在等。
